notes: Batch 012 follows the v1.9 planner exactly: patch effectiveness verification, standard-change scope drift, incident reporting under uncertainty, audit independence, volatile evidence, multi-region DNS dependency, backup restore evidence, classification-based contractor handling, orphan service identities, controlled detection simulation, encrypted-backup classification, constrained-WAN capacity/QoS, legal hold, DevSecOps lifecycle integration, DRM, and AI-assisted software-change provenance.
